senses.gloss: (b. h.; דָּלַל) [to be suspended, swing; denom. דֳּלִי; whence]

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 93">Gen. R. s. 93</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:32">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>אנשים דּוֹלִים וכ׳</he> men draw the water and women water the flock; a. fr.—
Yoma 28ᵇ (play on ד̇מ̇ש̇ק̇, Gen. XV, 2) שדּוֹֹלֶה ומ̇ש̇ק̇ה וכ׳ he (Eliezer) drew and gave to drink of his master’s teachings.—2) to lift up, relieve.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. I, 3</cite> <he>וכשיִדְלֵנִי וכ׳</he> and when the Lord shall lift me up out of the depths of suffering.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:1">Cant. R. to II, 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 51b:16">B. Kam. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>המַדְלֶה מים וכ׳</he> he who draws water (to irrigate his field &c.); <he>ואני אַדְלֶה</he> and I will &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (denom. of דָּלִית) to suspend, to train a plant to an espalier &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 1:4">Succ. I, 4</cite> <he>ה׳ עליה וכ׳</he> if he trained a vine over the festive wreath.
Kil. VI, 4; a. fr.—Part. pass. מוּדְלֶה, f. מוּדְלָה.
<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 3:8">Midd. III, 8</cite>. Y. B. Mets. X, 12ᶜ, v. <cite ref="D00838"><he>דָּלִית</he></cite>.—Bab.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 91b:13">ib. 91ᵇ</cite> <he>במוּדָלוֹת</he> Ms. F. (ed. <he>במודלית</he>) when figs and grapes overhang one another. [Y. Shebi. II, 33ᶜ bot. <cite ref="M00414"><he>מודלה</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="M00307"><he>מִדְלַעַת</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Moed Katan 4a:22">M. Kat. 4ᵃ</cite> sq., v. <cite ref="D00841"><he>דָּלַל</he></cite>.
